body:
Sorry about that, I forgot about the decorator shapes.

The AI proposed fix is not the correct one. In the case of an `Area3D` we wrap the entire (compound) shape in a `JoltCustomDoubleSidedShape` meaning that the proposed fix will not unpack the shape and when you set `PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.collide_with_areas = true` you will get the original bug back.

Next to `JoltCustomDoubleSidedShape` we are also ignoring `JoltCustomUserDataShape`, but I think this is not a problem as eventually we'll call `shaped_object->find_shape_index(hit.mSubShapeID2)` which uses the root rather than the leaf shape, so will not ignore the custom user data.

Now to come up with a fix...
